title: [ingest] feat(loop): hold-merge mode — autonomous loop builds in isolation, never merges
summary: Under the heartbeat loop, code-producing work is queued for human review instead of auto-merged or escalated mid-run: - orch-loop: every spawned code task works in an isolated orch/attempt/<slug> worktree off the code repo, commits there, completes as "MERGE PENDING" — never edits the live checkout, never merges to main. - self-learn-judge: hold-merge override — pick the winner but do NOT merge or remove worktrees...
